summary: Comprehensive frontend UI testing completed for HR Tunes music learning platform. All pages render correctly, navigation works, all data-testids are present, interactive elements respond properly (toasts, state changes), and the dark red/black/white theme is consistently applied.
test_credentials: No credentials required - UI-only auth with mock data
seed_data_creation: N/A - App uses static mock data from /app/frontend/src/lib/mock.js
context_for_next_testing_agent: This is a pure frontend UI app with mock data. All pages tested: Landing (hero, courses, instructor, testimonials, pricing, video), Auth (login/signup with role toggle), Student Dashboard (stats, courses, live, activity), My Courses (filters, course cards), Course Detail (video, curriculum, mark complete), Live Classes (calendar, timezone, sessions), Assignments (tabs), Payments (plan, history), Profile (form, save), Instructor Panel (5 tabs: overview, courses, schedule, students, uploads), Checkout (plans, payment methods, form). Mobile menu also tested.
